caption:
India vs Pakistan. In a final.

India's young side beat Bhutan 2-1 in Dhaka last night: Vishnu PV and captain Chinglensana Singh scored inside 30 minutes, Bhutan pulled one back after the break, and VAR (a first at the SAFF Championship) cancelled an India penalty along the way.

Hours later, Pakistan stunned hosts Bangladesh 1-0 with a late goal to reach their first ever SAFF Championship final.

The two met on November 5. India led 3-0, then let in two in added time and won 3-2. The rematch is Tuesday, 7:30 pm IST, with India chasing a record-extending 10th title.
